note: EXEC-SCREENER-FLOW-CANDLES P6 (verification/screener/P6_CANDLES.md; user decisions 2026-11-07 "2A": the patterns live in the Backtest core, used by the Screener and later the Backtest; K2 "A"). The 20 candlestick patterns of the proposal (FUTURE_PLAN SCREENER-FLOW-CANDLES section B, commit 5f719923) as data: every pattern is a list of rules over the candle primitives of its candles, evaluated by the one evaluator in candles.ts (no pattern has geometry of its own outside this file). Candles are numbered 1 (the oldest) to `bars` (the signal bar, where the pattern is flagged). An expression is a number, "$<parameter>", [<primitive>, <candle>], ["avg_body"], or ["+"|"-"|"*", a, b, ...], ["abs", a], ["ticks", a, b]. Comparisons are written without division, so integer prices compare exactly. The IDX guards (a candle that did not trade, a range under min_range_ticks) and the prior trend (`trend`: the direction the pattern needs, read on the session before candle 1) are applied by the evaluator to every pattern. Mirror: the pattern the same rules give on mirrored prices (p -> M - p); pair: the bullish / bearish pair of the proposal's list (Hammer / Hanging Man share a shape and differ by the trend only, so mirrored prices turn a Hammer into a Shooting Star).
tick_source: IDX price fractions (fraksi harga) of shares, in force since 2016-01-06: below Rp 200 Rp 1; Rp 200 to below Rp 500 Rp 2; Rp 500 to below Rp 2,000 Rp 5; Rp 2,000 to below Rp 5,000 Rp 10; Rp 5,000 and above Rp 25. A range is counted in ticks band by band (a candle across a band boundary counts each part in its own band's tick), on the adjusted prices the core reads, so an adjusted history is measured with the band of its adjusted price.

primitives.top: top of the body: max(open, close)
primitives.bottom: bottom of the body: min(open, close)
primitives.dir: colour: +1 white (close > open), -1 black (close < open), 0 neither
primitives.avg_body: the average body of the body_avg_length sessions before candle 1 (each of them with an open and a close)

trend.label: Prior trend measured by
trend.meaning: How the trend before the pattern is read, on the session before its first candle: average = the close is below (a bullish pattern) or above (a bearish one) its own average of the last trend-length sessions; change = the close is below / above the close trend-length sessions earlier; none = no trend test. Off (none) by default: set average or change to require the decline (a bullish pattern) or the rise (a bearish one) the pattern is read after.

trend_length.label: Trend sessions
trend_length.meaning: Sessions of the average, or how many sessions back the change is measured.

min_range_ticks.label: Minimum range (ticks)
min_range_ticks.meaning: Every candle of the pattern spans at least this many price ticks of its price band (IDX tick sizes from Rp 1 below Rp 200 to Rp 25 from Rp 5,000); a narrower candle is too coarse to show a shape.

body_avg_length.label: Average body of (sessions)
body_avg_length.meaning: The sessions before the pattern whose average body a long candle is measured against.

long_body.label: Long body (x average)
long_body.meaning: A long candle's body is at least this multiple of the average body; 0 switches the size test off (the average still needs its sessions).

patterns.name: Hammer
patterns.summary: After a decline, one candle with a small body at the top of its range and a long lower shadow: sellers pushed the price down and buyers took it back by the close.
patterns.misuse: A Hammer and a Hanging Man are the same shape; only the trend before tells them apart, so the trend test cannot be switched off. A single candle is weak evidence on its own; confirm with the next session or another condition.

params.meaning: How the trend before the pattern is read, on the session before its candle: average = the close is below (a bullish pattern) or above (a bearish one) its own average of the last trend-length sessions; change = below / above the close trend-length sessions earlier. The test cannot be switched off: the trend is what tells this pattern from its same-shape pair.

params.label: Body at most (% of range)
params.meaning: The body is at most this share of the candle's range.

params.label: Long shadow at least (x body)
params.meaning: The long shadow is at least this multiple of the body.

params.label: Other shadow at most (% of range)
params.meaning: The shadow on the other side is at most this share of the range.

rules.text: the body is at most body_max_pct % of the range
the lower shadow is at least shadow_ratio times the body
the upper shadow is at most short_shadow_pct % of the range

patterns.name: Hanging Man
patterns.summary: After a rise, one candle with a small body at the top of its range and a long lower shadow: the session's selling hints that the rise is tiring.
patterns.misuse: The Hammer's shape after a rise; only the trend before tells them apart, so the trend test cannot be switched off. Weak alone: it is commonly confirmed by a lower close the next session.

patterns.misuse: The Shooting Star's shape after a decline; only the trend before tells them apart, so the trend test cannot be switched off. The classic definition also wants a gap down, which the IDX rarely shows, so it is not required here.

patterns.name: Dragonfly Doji
patterns.summary: Open and close at or near the high after a long lower shadow: the session's selling was fully bought back.
patterns.misuse: A day without trades (open = high = low = close, volume 0) or a suspended day is never a doji. A Dragonfly Doji is also a Hammer when the trends agree. Weak alone.

params.label: Body at most (% of range)
params.meaning: A doji's body is at most this share of its range.

params.label: Upper shadow at most (% of range)
params.meaning: The upper shadow is at most this share of the range.

rules.text: the body is at most doji_body_pct % of the range
the upper shadow is at most short_shadow_pct % of the range

patterns.name: Gravestone Doji
patterns.summary: Open and close at or near the low after a long upper shadow: the session's buying was fully sold back.
patterns.misuse: A day without trades (open = high = low = close, volume 0) or a suspended day is never a doji. A Gravestone Doji is also a Shooting Star when the trends agree. Weak alone.

params.label: Body at most (% of range)

the lower shadow is at most short_shadow_pct % of the range

patterns.name: Bullish Marubozu
patterns.summary: A long white candle with almost no shadows: buyers in control from the open to the close.
patterns.misuse: A strength candle rather than a reversal, so the trend test is off by default. A long body is measured against the stock's own recent bodies.

params.label: Body at least (% of range)
params.meaning: The body is at least this share of the range, so the two shadows together are at most the rest.

rules.text: the candle is white (close above open)
the body is at least body_min_pct % of the range
the body is at least long_body times the average body

patterns.name: Bearish Marubozu
patterns.summary: A long black candle with almost no shadows: sellers in control from the open to the close.
patterns.misuse: A strength candle rather than a reversal, so the trend test is off by default. A long body is measured against the stock's own recent bodies.

params.label: Body at least (% of range)
params.meaning: The body is at least this share of the range, so the two shadows together are at most the rest.

rules.text: the candle is black (close below open)
the body is at least body_min_pct % of the range
the body is at least long_body times the average body

patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing
patterns.summary: After a decline, a white candle whose body covers the whole body of the black candle before it.
patterns.misuse: On the IDX the open is usually at or near the previous close, so the white body may start at the black candle's close (equal counts). The bodies are compared, not the shadows.

rules.text: candle 1 is black
candle 2 is white
candle 2 opens at or below candle 1's close
candle 2 closes at or above candle 1's open
candle 2's body is longer than candle 1's

patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing
patterns.summary: After a rise, a black candle whose body covers the whole body of the white candle before it.
patterns.misuse: On the IDX the open is usually at or near the previous close, so the black body may start at the white candle's close (equal counts). The bodies are compared, not the shadows.

rules.text: candle 1 is white
candle 2 is black
candle 2 opens at or above candle 1's close
candle 2 closes at or below candle 1's open
candle 2's body is longer than candle 1's

patterns.name: Bullish Harami
patterns.summary: After a decline, a long black candle followed by a small body inside its body: the selling paused.
patterns.misuse: The second candle may be of either colour (a doji inside makes a harami cross). It signals a pause more than a turn; confirm it.

params.label: Inside body at most (% of the first)
params.meaning: The second body is at most this share of the first candle's body.

rules.text: candle 1 is black
candle 1's body is at least long_body times the average body
candle 2's body top is at or below candle 1's open
candle 2's body bottom is at or above candle 1's close
candle 2's body is at most inside_max_pct % of candle 1's body

patterns.name: Bearish Harami
patterns.summary: After a rise, a long white candle followed by a small body inside its body: the buying paused.
patterns.misuse: The second candle may be of either colour (a doji inside makes a harami cross). It signals a pause more than a turn; confirm it.

params.label: Inside body at most (% of the first)
params.meaning: The second body is at most this share of the first candle's body.

rules.text: candle 1 is white
candle 1's body is at least long_body times the average body
candle 2's body top is at or below candle 1's close
candle 2's body bottom is at or above candle 1's open
candle 2's body is at most inside_max_pct % of candle 1's body

patterns.name: Piercing Line
patterns.summary: After a decline, a long black candle, then a white candle that opens lower and closes past the middle of the black body.
patterns.misuse: The classic definition opens the white candle below the black candle's low (a gap), which the IDX rarely shows; by default it only has to open below the black candle's close (the setting "opens beyond the first's: range" restores the classic test).

params.label: Second candle opens beyond the first's
params.meaning: close: candle 2 opens below candle 1's close; range: below candle 1's low (the classic gap).

params.label: Closes into the first body at least (%)
params.meaning: Candle 2 closes at least this share of candle 1's body above candle 1's close.

rules.text: candle 1 is black
candle 1's body is at least long_body times the average body
candle 2 is white
candle 2 opens below candle 1's close
candle 2 opens below candle 1's low
candle 2 closes at least penetration_pct % of candle 1's body above candle 1's close
candle 2 closes below candle 1's open

patterns.name: Dark Cloud Cover
patterns.summary: After a rise, a long white candle, then a black candle that opens higher and closes past the middle of the white body.
patterns.misuse: The classic definition opens the black candle above the white candle's high (a gap), which the IDX rarely shows; by default it only has to open above the white candle's close (the setting "opens beyond the first's: range" restores the classic test).

params.label: Second candle opens beyond the first's
params.meaning: close: candle 2 opens above candle 1's close; range: above candle 1's high (the classic gap).

params.label: Closes into the first body at least (%)
params.meaning: Candle 2 closes at least this share of candle 1's body below candle 1's close.

rules.text: candle 1 is white
candle 1's body is at least long_body times the average body
candle 2 is black
candle 2 opens above candle 1's close
candle 2 opens above candle 1's high
candle 2 closes at least penetration_pct % of candle 1's body below candle 1's close
candle 2 closes above candle 1's open

patterns.name: Tweezer Bottom
patterns.summary: After a decline, a black candle and then a white candle with the same low (within the tolerance): the low was tested twice and held.
patterns.misuse: The lows are compared in price ticks, so the tolerance means the same on a Rp 100 stock and a Rp 9,000 stock. Weak alone.

params.label: Lows equal within (ticks)
params.meaning: The two lows are at most this many price ticks apart (0 = exactly equal).

rules.text: candle 1 is black
candle 2 is white
the two lows are at most tolerance_ticks price ticks apart

patterns.name: Tweezer Top
patterns.summary: After a rise, a white candle and then a black candle with the same high (within the tolerance): the high was tested twice and held.
patterns.misuse: The highs are compared in price ticks, so the tolerance means the same on a Rp 100 stock and a Rp 9,000 stock. Weak alone.

params.label: Highs equal within (ticks)
params.meaning: The two highs are at most this many price ticks apart (0 = exactly equal).

rules.text: candle 1 is white
candle 2 is black
the two highs are at most tolerance_ticks price ticks apart

patterns.name: Morning Star
patterns.summary: After a decline, a long black candle, a small-bodied star at its bottom, and a white candle closing well into the black body.
patterns.misuse: The classic star gaps below the first body, which the IDX rarely shows; the relaxed gap lets the star's body reach into the first body by the share set in "Star may reach into the first body" (0: touching; a negative share asks for a real gap).

params.label: Star body at most (% of the first)
params.meaning: The middle candle's body is at most this share of the first candle's body.

params.label: Star may reach into the first body (%)
params.meaning: The relaxed body gap: the star's body top is at most this share of the first body above the first candle's close (0 = touching; negative = a real gap of that size).

params.label: Third closes into the first body at least (%)
params.meaning: The third candle closes at least this share of the first body above the first candle's close.

rules.text: candle 1 is black
candle 1's body is at least long_body times the average body
the star's body is at most star_body_pct % of candle 1's body
the star's body top is at most star_overlap_pct % of candle 1's body above candle 1's close (relaxed gap)
candle 3 is white
candle 3 closes at least penetration_pct % of candle 1's body above candle 1's close

patterns.name: Evening Star
patterns.summary: After a rise, a long white candle, a small-bodied star at its top, and a black candle closing well into the white body.
patterns.misuse: The classic star gaps above the first body, which the IDX rarely shows; the relaxed gap lets the star's body reach into the first body by the share set in "Star may reach into the first body" (0: touching; a negative share asks for a real gap).

params.label: Star body at most (% of the first)
params.meaning: The middle candle's body is at most this share of the first candle's body.

params.label: Star may reach into the first body (%)
params.meaning: The relaxed body gap: the star's body bottom is at most this share of the first body below the first candle's close (0 = touching; negative = a real gap of that size).

params.label: Third closes into the first body at least (%)
params.meaning: The third candle closes at least this share of the first body below the first candle's close.

rules.text: candle 1 is white
candle 1's body is at least long_body times the average body
the star's body is at most star_body_pct % of candle 1's body
the star's body bottom is at most star_overlap_pct % of candle 1's body below candle 1's close (relaxed gap)
candle 3 is black
candle 3 closes at least penetration_pct % of candle 1's body below candle 1's close

patterns.name: Three White Soldiers
patterns.summary: After a decline or a base, three long white candles in a row, each opening inside the previous body and closing higher, near its high.
patterns.misuse: Three strong sessions after a decline; late in a long rise the same shape can mean exhaustion, which the trend test excludes when it is set (it is off by default).

params.label: Each body at least (% of range)
params.meaning: Each candle's body is at least this share of its range.

params.label: Each upper shadow at most (% of range)
params.meaning: Each candle closes near its high: its upper shadow is at most this share of its range.

rules.text: candle 1 is white
candle 2 is white
candle 3 is white
candle 1's body is at least body_min_pct % of its range
candle 2's body is at least body_min_pct % of its range
candle 3's body is at least body_min_pct % of its range
candle 1's upper shadow is at most short_shadow_pct % of its range
candle 2's upper shadow is at most short_shadow_pct % of its range
candle 3's upper shadow is at most short_shadow_pct % of its range
candle 1's body is at least long_body times the average body
candle 2's body is at least long_body times the average body
candle 3's body is at least long_body times the average body
candle 2 opens at or above candle 1's open
candle 2 opens at or below candle 1's close (inside its body)
candle 3 opens at or above candle 2's open
candle 3 opens at or below candle 2's close (inside its body)
candle 2 closes above candle 1
candle 3 closes above candle 2

patterns.name: Three Black Crows
patterns.summary: After a rise, three long black candles in a row, each opening inside the previous body and closing lower, near its low.
patterns.misuse: Three weak sessions after a rise; late in a long decline the same shape can mean capitulation, which the trend test excludes when it is set (it is off by default).

params.label: Each lower shadow at most (% of range)
